abstract: This study examines the impact of generative AI assistance on worker productivity in a real-world setting. The authors find that access to AI tools increases productivity by 15% on average as measured by issues resolved per hour, with significant variation in effects across different types of workers.
keyFindings: Access to AI assistance increases worker productivity by 15% on average, measured by issues resolved per hour.
Substantial heterogeneity exists in productivity gains across workers.
AI adoption shows measurable real-world impacts on task completion rates.
